title: Ram Rajya
desc: Lord Rama returns to Ayodhya with his wife Sita after defeating Ravana in an epic battle. However, he exiles his wife when people start doubting her purity.

title: Train To Pakistan
desc: The film is set in Mano Majra, which is a quiet fictional village on the border of India and Pakistan, close to where the railway line crosses the Sutlej River. The film develops around the love affair of small-time dacoit Juggut Singh (Nirmal Pandey), with a local Muslim girl, Nooran (Smriti Mishra).

title: Tyagi
desc: Shankar takes the blame when one of his brothers is accused of a murder. However, when he returns from jail, he realises that his brothers are trying to create a rift in the family.

title: Kohram
desc: Major Ajit is assigned to expose Major Sodhi, the man who attempted to kill the Home Minister and is now hiding under a guise. Major Ajit sets out on his mission, but when he learns Sodhi's reasons for doing what he did, Ajit joins hands with him.

title: Nishchaiy
desc: When Ravi is falsely accused of a crime and sentenced to jail, his boss's wife, Renuka, promises to take care of his younger brother. However, Ravi is unable to find his brother after he is released.

title: Khoon Ka Karz
desc: Two young friends are raised in the same orphanage by an affectionate warden. Although they promise her not to stray, fate makes them the biggest gangsters in town. Will she be able to save them now?
